prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic outdoor lifestyle portrait of an approved adult red-haired woman cycling through a quiet suburban street.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with red hair tied back, fair freckled skin, and a calm confident expression. She sits upright facing forward with both hands on the handlebars and wears a simple fitted red sleeveless one-piece outfit.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered eye-level portrait on a classic bright yellow city bicycle. Include a single-story light house, trimmed bushes, tall trees, stone boundary wall, concrete pavement, and smooth asphalt road.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daytime light with a peaceful, confident, fresh suburban mood and realistic hair, skin, fabric, bicycle, and greenery texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photograph, centered symmetrical framing, eye-level perspective, 4:5 vertical composition, sharp subject, natural color palette with red, yellow, green, blue, grey, and white.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 outdoor lifestyle portrait of an approved adult red-haired woman with fair freckled skin cycling a bright yellow classic city bicycle along a quiet suburban street. Tie her red hair back, give her a calm confident expression, and show her seated upright facing forward with both hands on the handlebars. Dress her in a simple fitted red sleeveless one-piece outfit. Center the subject at eye level with a light single-story house, trimmed bushes, tall trees, stone boundary wall, concrete pavement, and asphalt road behind her. Use natural daytime light, realistic textures, peaceful fresh mood, and balanced symmetrical framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, malformed bicycle
